## Summary

Describe what this change does and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI, or security

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo audit`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets --all-features --locked`
- [ ] Tests or manual checks described below

If any check could not be run, explain why:

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, secrets, personal data, or private media files are included.
- [ ] Any new filesystem, process, permission, or network behavior is documented.
- [ ] Dependencies were reviewed for necessity and risk.

## Documentation and UX

- [ ] Documentation updated where needed.
- [ ] Screenshots included for relevant UI changes.

## Additional context

Add relevant issue links, screenshots, or implementation notes.
